title: Normalized algebraic residue towers and finite constant realization
statement: For a commutative ring A and ideal J, a normalized algebraic residue tower consists of E_n in D(A/J^(n+1)), transitions E_(n+1) to the exact restriction of E_n, left adjoints to restriction from A and between consecutive quotients, invertible adjuncts of the transitions, and perfect E_0. Algebraic derived categories use the Grothendieck small localization at the coefficient universe. No finiteness of the underlying quotient sets is assumed. For a scheme X and an object U of its coefficient-sized pro-etale site model, c_(U,n):D(A/J^(n+1)) to D(U,underline(A/J^(n+1))) is the recorded exact commutative constant-module realization followed by actual slice restriction. Its target uses the standard localization of the constant-completion coefficient package. This uses [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor] and [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons].
